note: The wicked kingdom decreed that the Jews must not study Torah, must not circumcise their sons, and must desecrate Shabbat. Yehuda ben Shammua and his colleagues went for advice to a certain matron whom all the leading men of Rome visited. She told them to cry out at night. They went and cried out: O Heavens! Are we not your brothers, children of one father and one mother? How are we different from every other nation, that you issue harsh decrees against us? The decrees were annulled, and that day, the twenty-eighth of Adar, was made a festive day.
why: The Gemara is asking whether Megillat Ta'anit has been cancelled. Rav Tovi bar Mattana objects with this festive day, added after the Temple's destruction: no one adds days to a list that was cancelled.
